test_cases.clause_text: The Consultant agrees that for a period of two years following termination of this Agreement, they shall not engage in, advise, or conduct any competing software development business anywhere in India.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Commercial restrictive covenants restraining lawful trade or profession directly trigger Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872.

test_cases.clause_text: The parties acknowledge and agree that this Agreement and any amendment or acceptance expressed by electronic record or email communication shall be legally binding and enforceable.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Enforceability of contracts formed through electronic communications is governed by Section 10A of the Information Technology Act, 2000.

test_cases.clause_text: The parties agree that specific performance of this contract shall be enforced by the court in the event of default.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Mandatory specific performance of contracts subject to statutory exceptions is governed by Section 10 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963 (as amended in 2018).

test_cases.clause_text: Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this contract shall be submitted to arbitration in writing in accordance with the Arbitration Rules.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Requirements for a valid written arbitration agreement are defined under Section 7 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

test_cases.clause_text: All computerized output, system logs, and digital records generated during performance shall be admissible as documentary evidence in judicial proceedings.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Admissibility and legal validity of electronic and digital records are governed by Section 61 and Section 63 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

test_cases.clause_text: If Vendor fails to deliver by the milestone date, Vendor shall pay fifty thousand rupees per day as agreed compensation for breach of contract, without prejudice to actual loss.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Compensation for breach of contract where penalty or stipulated amount is named is governed by Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872.

test_cases.clause_text: The data fiduciary must provide itemised notice to the data principal before requesting consent for processing digital personal data.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: While enacted, Section 5 of the DPDP Act, 2023 has not been officially commenced by Central Government notification, requiring mandatory system abstention.

test_cases.clause_text: User shall not transmit any offensive message or communication causing annoyance, inconvenience or ill will through the computer resource.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Section 66A of the IT Act was struck down as unconstitutional by the Supreme Court in Shreya Singhal (2015) and is repealed/void, triggering abstention.

test_cases.clause_text: Thermal dissipation in superconducting quantum circuits operates through relativistic neutrino interaction across planetary orbits.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Completely non-legal text must fail to match any commercial statutory provision and trigger immediate abstention.

test_cases.clause_text: This Agreement and all internal corporate affairs shall be governed by the Delaware General Corporation Law and Delaware Chancery Court jurisdiction.
test_cases.evidence_rationale: Delaware state corporate law is outside the Indian statutory corpus and must cleanly abstain.
